listing.name: Lancer RPG/Battlegroup 0.0.1 [WIP}
listing.summary: A mod which adds in ships, weapons, and (in the future) factions from Massif Press's Lancer RPG setting.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a Lancer RPG-themed cruiser and weapon to Starsector.

description:
Lancer RPG/Battlegroup

From a distance, it is elegant; Up close, it is hell.

Download version 0.0.1

Overview

This is a ship, weapon, and eventually (if all goes as planned :P) a faction mod based on the

Lancer

RPG setting created by Massif Press. Currently, there is one cruiser* and one weapon implemented.

This is a very tentative state of affairs, and any feedback (balancing, bugs, etc.) is highly appreciated.

*A note on terminology. In the Lancer setting, frigates are the second largest direct combat vessels and the smallest lineships (after the battleships), thus being the equivalent to the cruisers of most settings. Cruisers, destroyers and corvettes are terms reserved for subline ships that rely on dedicated tenders or carriers.

Features

The Caspian Sea: a dependable, if expensive cruiser with several universal slots and a target lock ship system that amplifies damage done to a single target. For now, it is currently available in the high-tech blueprint package, as a rare Independent ship, and as a solo drop. The Short-cycle Primary Lance: a large energy weapon which acts as something of a direct progression from the Phase Lance. It is significantly shorter ranged than the Tachyon Lance, but does significantly more damage. Available from the same sources as the Caspian Sea.

Sprites (commissioned from Tandem Charge (@TandemCharge on X/Twitter))

Spoiler Caspian Sea

Short Cycle Primary Lance

[close]

Other Credits

This mod was (badly) created using wispborne's Intellij template (

https://github.com/wispborne/Starsector-IntelliJ-Template

).

It made the process much easier than it would have been otherwise.
